### [`start_script`](../../../../src/leftovers/leftover_0a68.asm#L11) `$0A81`

*routine*

Runs the start-up script at $1def. Its op 9 jumps to the disk protection at $393d. No code calls this routine in the Mayday! release (see $0955).
